defaults.video_script: Mexico City, nineteen eighty-six. Argentina against England, four years after the Falklands War. Diego Maradona rose with the goalkeeper and punched the ball into the net with his left hand. The referee never saw it. He gave the goal. Four minutes later, Maradona picked the ball up inside his own half, beat five England players, and scored what the world later voted the greatest goal ever. He called the first one the Hand of God.

videos.video_script: Mexico City, nineteen eighty-six. Argentina against England, four years after the Falklands War. Diego Maradona rose with the goalkeeper and punched the ball into the net with his left hand. The referee never saw it. He gave the goal. Four minutes later, Maradona picked the ball up inside his own half, beat five England players, and scored what the world later voted the greatest goal ever. He called the first one the Hand of God.
